verdict.rationale: The docs describe spawning multiple Claude Code agents that work simultaneously under a lead agent that assigns subtasks and merges results. The web and cloud version lets users kick off long-running tasks, check back when they're done, and run multiple tasks in parallel, and the desktop app runs multiple sessions side by side and launches cloud sessions. Scheduling and the sandbox support unattended autonomous execution. Missing for 10: any documented duration of hours or days for agent runs, stated fleet scale or concurrency limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long parallel runs.
